subject.title: Feishu auto-reply and `message` tool path bypass `message_sending` / `reply_payload_sending` / `message_sent` plugin hooks

question: Should this issue be split so Feishu outbound hook parity is fixed first while normal-channel `inbound_claim` broadening is tracked as a separate plugin API/security decision?
rationale: The remaining outbound gap is a documented hook-coverage bug, but changing normal-channel `inbound_claim` semantics would alter claim authority and ordering for all channel traffic.

options.title: Split outbound parity from inbound claim
options.body: Fix Feishu outbound `message_sending` coverage under the existing dispatcher/hook seam and track normal-channel `inbound_claim` separately.

options.title: Fold all hook work into an umbrella item
options.body: Move the Feishu evidence into the broader outbound-hook canonical issue and leave this item only for inbound-claim API discussion.

options.title: Solve every requested hook together
options.body: Use one broader design PR for outbound parity and normal inbound claiming, accepting higher compatibility and security review cost.

recommendation.title: Split outbound parity from inbound claim
recommendation.body: Fix Feishu outbound `message_sending` coverage under the existing dispatcher/hook seam and track normal-channel `inbound_claim` separately.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision includes `inbound_claim` and plugin conversation-binding semantics from the plugin-surface work they authored.
